Hi Alice — thanks for the note and the docs. Added Marissa (Customer Success) and Ben (Sales/Finance liaison) so they see the change.

Short answers:
- We can reissue the outstanding Oct invoice to Northbridge and update future invoices as requested.
- We need a completed W-9 on file (you attached one, thanks) and the company legal name exactly as you want it to appear on invoices.
- For bank-routing changes, our collections team needs the bank details in a signed bank instruction PDF (you referenced one — can you confirm attachment or send a bank letter from Northbridge?).

Can you confirm the legal payee name (legal entity vs. trading name) and whether Northbridge wants invoices sent to the same AP email (ap@stellarcare.com) or a new address (e.g., ap@northbridge.com)? Once we have that plus the signed bank instruction, we can:
1) Reissue the Oct invoice (INV-2026-10-2897) to the new payee.
2) Update the billing portal and remittance instructions.
3) Flag the account so collections routes payments to the new bank details.

I’ll put a tentative target of Tue 10/6 for invoice reissue pending docs.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Manager — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
